sentences.en: All the members of the committee consented to my proposal.
sentences.zh: 委员会的所有成员都同意了我的提议。

sentences.en: His mother will not consent to his going there alone.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲不同意他独自去那里。

sentences.en: She has consented to take the leadership of the party.
sentences.zh: 她同意担任该党领导人的职务。

senses.zh: 同意；（意见等的）一致；赞成
